lines: Night one. The guns of the ridge never stopped.
five men of the Hegemony did not see the morning.
Bram Yoollyfox. Pavel Zulfi. Nils Wolfmananton. Oskar Brunoescobar. And one more.
Each has a name, a grave, and a family that sends another.
23 more of the Hegemony lie wounded. The barrage is not over.
